newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Moscow region names SBC Warburg to lead Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Moscow region names SBC Warburg to lead Eurobond.

text.p: Moscow region named SBC Warburg to lead manage its planned Eurobond issue, a senior official of Unikombank, the region's financial agent, said on Monday.
When asked who will lead manage the forthcoming Eurobond issue, Unikombank deputy chairman Konstantin Merzlikin told Reuters: "SBC Warburg."
Merzlikin said the volume of the issue was likely to be less than $400 million and maturity would be three to five years.
He also said the region had chosen IBCA and Moody's as its rating agencies and expected to receive the rating in May.
Merzlikin said the region planned to register its issue prospectus with the Finance Ministry in May.
Apart from Moscow region, the City of Moscow is also planning to issue a three to five year Eurobond soon. The road-show for the $400-$500 million issue is scheduled for May 11-25.
